events.title: Demo Updates!
events.summary: Demo Updates First, I want to thank the hundreds of you who tried our demo last weekend. Most especially, I want to thank those who provided us with your feedback. Your bug reports, suggestions, and constructive criticisms are helping us make the game better, please keep them coming! events.title: Over 1,000 Wishlists - Thank You!
events.summary: I started making games because I wanted to create things people could enjoy that would spark their imagination. One of the happiest moments in my entire career was when someone drew fan art for a mobile game my friends and I created in college and sent it to us. No amount of commercial success could ever top the joy and sense of accomplishment that one drawing brought me. Now to surge past 1,000 wishlists in just a few days after releasing our page and seeing so many people excited for the game

events.title: Over 500 Wishlists Day 1!
events.summary: We are completely humbled by the incredible support you’ve shown us since we launched our Steam page only a day ago! Surpassing 500 wishlists on our first day is beyond anything we could have imagined. The outpouring of excitement and interest has made us feel truly confident that we’re creating something you’ll love, and we are fully committed to keep flying until we live up to those expectations.
